categories.main_business_segments: MEDIA DO operates two main business segments: the Electronic Book Distribution Business, which includes digital content distribution and eBook store operations, and the Strategic Investment Business, which covers imprint publishing, IP/solution services, international business, and the FanTop NFT marketplace. The Electronic Book Distribution Business is the core segment, accounting for over 90% of consolidated revenue, while the Strategic Investment Business is positioned as a secondary growth pillar.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary digital content distribution systems, such as the Contents Agency System (CAS), and provides eBook store and distribution platforms. It also develops solutions for multi-language translation (MDTS), SaaS-based publishing workflow tools, and NFT-based digital content distribution. Production methods emphasize system integration, digital rights management, and scalable cloud-based infrastructure.
categories.primary_customers_markets: MEDIA DO primarily serves publishers (including major Japanese publishing houses), eBook retailers, and content holders. Its end markets include digital book consumers, libraries, and, through its international segment, overseas publishers and readers. Key customers include NTT Solmare and Amazon, which together account for over 40% of segment sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are in Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales, but it also has a growing international presence, particularly in North America and Europe through subsidiaries and partnerships. Key overseas subsidiaries include Media Do International (US), Quality Solutions (US), NetGalley (US/UK/France), and Supadü (UK).
categories.supply_chain_position: MEDIA DO operates primarily as a midstream distributor and platform provider, acting as an intermediary between publishers (upstream) and eBook retailers or end-users (downstream). It also provides upstream services (content creation and publishing) and downstream solutions (retail, NFT distribution, and SaaS tools).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding digital content distribution beyond manga to text-based works and audiobooks, internationalizing Japanese content, and leveraging advanced technologies such as AI, Web3, and NFTs. The company is also focused on portfolio diversification, sustainability, regional empowerment, and strengthening information security and governance. R&D spending is modest, with emphasis on system development and digital transformation solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through commission-based eBook distribution (acting as a wholesaler/aggregator), direct sales from owned eBook stores, SaaS subscriptions for publishing workflow tools, and licensing/royalty income from content and IP. Additional revenue streams include NFT marketplace transactions and publishing sales (both digital and print).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: MEDIA DO is the largest eBook wholesaler/distributor in Japan, with a unique position as a neutral intermediary between most publishers and eBook retailers. Competitors include other digital content distributors, direct publisher-retailer relationships, and emerging digital platforms. The company differentiates itself through its scale, comprehensive service offering, and strong industry relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended February 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥101.9 billion (approx. $650 million), with operating profit of ¥2.5 billion and net profit of ¥1.36 billion. The company has returned to growth after a temporary decline, with a mid-term plan targeting ¥125 billion in revenue and ¥4 billion in operating profit by FY2030. The balance sheet is healthy, with improving equity ratio and positive cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MEDIA DO’s value proposition lies in its ability to provide a one-stop, scalable, and neutral digital distribution platform for publishers and retailers, ensuring fair compensation for creators and efficient content delivery. Its differentiation includes the breadth of its publisher and retailer network, proprietary technology, multi-format/multi-language capabilities, and innovative offerings such as NFT-linked publications and SaaS publishing tools.
